title: Calibration of explicit answer contracts, checked finalisation and bounded provider recovery
question: Do explicit answer templates and protocol-specific feedback reduce model completion failures, and how do separately retained checker outputs behave when model restatement is removed? Can bounded transient recovery preserve later assignments without losing unknown-cost accounting?

scope.system_or_population: One orders API, up to 40 purposively reviewed development cases and six pinned snapshots. Model finalisation assigns up to six prompt/tool arms; checked finalisation assigns only EAL/MCP and ordinary validator. Analyse each selected snapshot, transport and finalisation separately. A small calibration precedes an explicitly selected larger invocation; conclusions describe only that finite suite and invocation.
scope.conditions: Docker on one runner; real loopback HTTP evidence acquired once per case and frozen for every arm and model; live Responses API conversations; common text-mediated operation transport by default. Model and checked finalisation are distinct invocations with distinct assignment identities.
scope.spatial_scope: One container and its loopback network.
scope.temporal_scope: Each recorded invocation and model snapshot. Claims about freshness refer to the frozen case assessment time, not the later replay wall clock.
exclusions: Population efficacy or equivalence inference from development cases
A model being intrinsically unable to call tools merely because native function calling is disabled
Interpreting checked finalisation as model-authored answer accuracy

claims.statement: The version 5 instrument distinguishes model-authored decisions, deterministic finalisation and checked evidence usability from observed failed criteria. The EAL route obtains its finite decision from two typed method-backed claims; live version 5 behaviour remains unmeasured.

claims.success_consequence: Report calibration completion and diagnostic outcomes, followed only by an explicitly selected larger invocation; use finite-suite discordance to plan held-out investigation without declaring superiority.
claims.failure_consequence: Report continued ceiling, concordance or invalid measurement; revise the task or instrument before an efficacy study.

assumptions.statement: A fresh model session receives only its assigned prompt, case catalogue and tool results; shared evidence is immutable and no outcome leaks between arms.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Freeze assignments and evidence digests before paid calls; verify bundle hashes and keep separate transcripts. Record temporal ordering and provider identities.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Suspend affected comparisons and retain all assignments as an invalid or incomplete invocation.

assumptions.statement: The independent reference correctly distinguishes false checks from unknown checks and unavailable evidence from an adequately measured failed criterion, and grades finite scope, evidence selection and metrics.
assumptions.test_or_justification: Earlier invocations showed correct checked packets and model final-answer errors. Version 5 checks the source-level distinction between unusable evidence and an adequate negative result against independent raw rows, with real direct/MCP controls. Actual version 5 calibration remains pending.
assumptions.failure_consequence: Suspend affected scores; version the correction and use a new invocation without replacing earlier outcomes.

assumptions.statement: Purposive development cases cover useful engineering failure mechanisms but are not independent draws from a declared population of engineering tasks.
assumptions.test_or_justification: The case catalogue intentionally includes selected positive controls, performance failures, provenance failures and distractors.
assumptions.failure_consequence: No population confidence interval or efficacy decision is permitted under this protocol.

hypotheses.label: Discriminating evidence-handling cases
hypotheses.statement: With explicit check states and canonical decisions, at least one valid completed model/comparator cell contains a paired discordance attributable to a scored decision or evidence-handling error rather than lost provider metadata or ambiguous output fields.

hypotheses.label: Continued ceiling or complete concordance
hypotheses.statement: All completed valid paired cases remain concordant across every model/comparator cell, leaving no observed comparative error pattern for planning an efficacy study.

hypotheses.statement: Apparent paired differences remain attributable only to instrument defects, incomplete model calls, ambiguous visible-message operation transport or unattempted assignments rather than interpretable task decisions.

predictions.expected_pattern: At least one valid completed pair has exactly one fully correct arm, with component scores identifying the error; paired discordance counts are nonzero.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: One or more interpretable discordant case pairs; no minimum efficacy effect or statistical rejection threshold.
predictions.tolerance: Exact count, status, selected evidence, scope and separate failed/unknown check sets; reported p95 and error percentage within 0.01 units where computable.

predictions.expected_pattern: Direct inspection, conventional checking and MCP assessment pass mechanical controls before live calls; retained public response boundaries and termination metadata distinguish provider outcomes from valid model decisions.
predictions.magnitude_or_range: All required controls pass; control success alone cannot establish comparative model benefit.

constructs.name: Evidence-grounded finite-run decision
constructs.definition: The model selects and inspects candidate evidence. Model finalisation additionally requires model-authored status, checks and metrics; checked finalisation retains those fields directly from the selected checker. The host supplies immutable selection context, and narrative presence is measured separately.
constructs.scope: One orders API, up to 40 purposively reviewed development cases and six pinned snapshots. Model finalisation assigns up to six prompt/tool arms; checked finalisation assigns only EAL/MCP and ordinary validator. Analyse each selected snapshot, transport and finalisation separately. A small calibration precedes an explicitly selected larger invocation; conclusions describe only that finite suite and invocation.
validity_evidence: Independent reference over raw request rows and case provenance
Real HTTP/MCP controls and separate scored decision components
validity_threats: No assessment of argument source authoring
Purposive adversarial cases may favour executable checking
The host checker is part of the treatment
Narrative quality and private model reasoning are not graded

measurements.observable: Binary full correctness and its status, metric, evidence-selection, finite-scope, failed-check and unknown-check components; false support, false rejection, correct unavailability and unsupported assertions without collection; public response-message boundaries, provider status and incomplete_details, calls, usage, known costs and latency. Finalisation mode, answer origin, valid model finish versus retained answer completion, explanation presence and bounded provider retry counts remain separately observable.
measurements.instrument_or_procedure: Real perf_counter_ns HTTP acquisition; immutable evidence bundles; collector and independent raw-row reference; actual Responses API usage.
measurements.scale_or_units: Binary correctness; milliseconds; error percentage; count; USD estimates.
measurements.timing: Acquire and freeze each case before paid calls. Assess freshness at its recorded reference time. Fresh model conversations select and inspect evidence within fixed call limits.
measurements.preprocessing: Nearest-rank sample p95 over every attempted request; non-2xx and transport errors count as errors. Preserve raw durations. Provenance, stale, truncation and misleading-summary perturbations are explicit fault injections with retained originals.
measurements.calibration: Real HTTP and MCP route controls plus inclusive 200 ms, 1 percent and 100-request boundaries and evidence-validity controls; no simulated provider response counts as experimental evidence.
measurements.reliability: All arms and models use the same immutable case report bundle; reference grades actual raw timings, never the intended latency-profile label.
measurements.validity: Supported means adequate evidence meets every finite criterion. Unsupported means adequate evidence demonstrates at least one performance or sample-size criterion failure. Unavailable means provenance, freshness, completeness, integrity or consistency prevents that assessment. A false evaluated check enters failed_checks; a null check enters unknown_checks; true checks enter neither. Failed evidence validity can coexist with unknown performance. Only one canonical status is exposed in checked packets; raw EAL support remains in audit traces.
measurements.measurement_invariance: Within one finalisation mode, all selected arms share frozen evidence, the independent grader and host-bound context. Model finalisation uses six arms with optional narrative; checked finalisation uses EAL/MCP and ordinary validator only and retains their returned decisions without model restatement. Measurement-only arms never receive oracle-derived status or check sets. Do not pool finalisation modes.
measurements.reactivity: HTTP acquisition consumes local resources before model trials; replay prevents arm-dependent timing noise.
measurements.error_model: Retain every assignment with no effect-based stopping. Retry only provider-marked retryable http_server, timeout or transport failures, at most twice per trial after 1 and 2 seconds; every attempt uses the existing model-call cap and keeps unknown charges reserved. Exhausted transient retries fail that trial; three consecutive transient-failed trials stop the affected model. Known-cost invalid, incomplete or ambiguous replies fail their trial without retry. Fatal account/configuration errors, unclassified failures, unverified returned model identity or usage, host failures, checker/reference disagreement and exhausted admission allowance stop the model immediately. Preserve failed and unattempted assignments separately; instrument or evidence-integrity defects suspend affected comparisons.
measurements.blinding: Arm-independent deterministic grader uses frozen case evidence and answer fields; investigators and model prompts are unblinded.

design.rationale: Version 3.1 traces identify correct checker output followed by operation omissions, failed repair and incorrect restatement. Version 4 separates model restatement from checked finalisation, supplies explicit templates without oracle leakage and tests bounded recovery from transient provider failures.
design.setting: Controlled local HTTP service in Docker, with live remote model inference.
design.temporal_structure: Acquire case evidence once; freeze it and the assignment ledger before paid calls. Up to six concurrent model workers each follow a seeded case and arm order with fresh sessions.
design.assignment_method: Freeze seeded case and arm orders and selected finalisation before paid calls. Finalisation enters each assignment identity. Concurrent model workers preserve their frozen order; only prespecified transient provider retries may repeat a call within its original assignment.
design.allocation_concealment: Models see their current prompt and candidate report catalogue without case family labels, oracle results or other model answers.
design.comparator: Equivalent JSON semantic representation and three ordinary developer prompts use direct evidence tools without MCP or EAL assessment. A sixth arm uses the explicit prose prompt with an ordinary direct deterministic validator.

units.target_population_or_system: One orders API, up to 40 purposively reviewed development cases and six pinned snapshots. Model finalisation assigns up to six prompt/tool arms; checked finalisation assigns only EAL/MCP and ordinary validator. Analyse each selected snapshot, transport and finalisation separately. A small calibration precedes an explicitly selected larger invocation; conclusions describe only that finite suite and invocation.
units.sampling_frame: Forty reviewed development cases crossed with selected snapshots. Model finalisation uses six arms; checked finalisation uses EAL and ordinary validator only. Calibration selects healthy, corrupt and stale variant 0; model mode includes JSON and checked mode omits it.
units.experimental_unit: One fresh model conversation assigned to one arm and one immutable case bundle.
units.observational_unit: One retained result, labelled by model or checked origin; HTTP requests, tool operations, model calls and bounded retries remain nested measurements.
units.assignment_unit: Prompt/tool arm within finalisation, snapshot, transport and case block.
units.analysis_unit: Matched case pair for a fixed snapshot, transport, finalisation and comparator; never pool model tiers, transports or finalisation modes.
units.recruitment_or_selection: Purposive case-family and snapshot selection, with development data reserved for diagnosis and planning rather than confirmation.

interventions_or_exposures.description: Six frozen prompt/tool arms: EAL/MCP, equivalent JSON, brief prose, explicit prose, review prose and explicit prose with an ordinary direct validator.
interventions_or_exposures.target: Candidate evidence selection and correct bounded interpretation of its provenance and measured criteria.
interventions_or_exposures.implementation: Default text-mediated operations: the model emits a validated operation request, the host executes it, then returns the result. EAL requests invoke real stdio MCP; JSON/prose invoke direct tools, and only plain_validator receives ordinary deterministic assessment. No JSON/prose route invokes the EAL runtime. Native function calling is an optional separately labelled transport diagnostic. Distinct public provider messages remain separate; ambiguous multiple operations are not silently concatenated or salvaged. Version 4 requires explicit operation names, supplies mode-appropriate final templates and concise repair feedback, binds report_id/scope to inspected context and makes explanation optional. The checked finalisation mode automatically retains the tool decision after a successful inspection, without requiring model restatement. Measurement-only arms are excluded from that mode.
interventions_or_exposures.dose_or_intensity: Model finalisation: calibration 3 cases x 3 arms x 6 models = 54 assignments (9 for one model), smoke 4 x 6 x 6 = 144, pilot 40 x 6 x 6 = 1440. Checked finalisation: calibration 3 x 2 x 6 = 36 assignments (6 for one model), smoke 4 x 2 x 6 = 48, pilot 40 x 2 x 6 = 480. Calibration allows 3 model calls/trial and USD0.50/model; smoke and pilot allow 6 calls/trial and USD5/model or USD20/model respectively. All attempts, including transient retries, count against these call caps. All modes retain 4096 output tokens/call, 120-second request timeout, one-second spacing and up to six workers. No automatic larger run follows calibration.
interventions_or_exposures.timing: All evidence is acquired before model calls; arm order is seeded within each case block.
manipulation_checks: Retain every prompt, operation schema, report selection and tool trace
Verify JSON semantic equivalence with the reviewed EAL source for the same selected report
Native-disabled text transport must omit native tools from the provider request
Checked packets expose exactly one canonical status; raw EAL support is retained only in audit traces
Separate failed_checks for false predicates from unknown_checks for null predicates
Retain provider status, incomplete_details and distinct public message boundaries without retaining private reasoning payloads
Unchecked-arm templates contain no checker or oracle decision fields
Explicit report_id or scope conflicts are rejected rather than overwritten
Protocol errors do not alter previously supplied evidence
Every transient attempt occupies one retained call record and unknown charges remain reserved
Checked results identify their origin separately from a valid model finish
off_target_checks: Record tokens, calls, latency and component errors because prompt length and checking authority differ
Separate native/text diagnostic results; do not call a capable model inherently non-tooling
recovery_checks: New provider conversation and isolated trial directory for every assignment
Read-only shared case bundles and verified digests

controls.description: Adequate matching reports from real healthy HTTP workloads can support the finite claim.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Nonfunctional measurement, blocked tool route or checker that always refuses support.
controls.implementation: Run direct and actual MCP route controls before paid calls; retain supported positive cases in the development suite.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Do not start paid calls if a required mechanical positive control fails.

controls.description: Adequate real reports with latency/error/sample-size failures must be unsupported; stale, mismatched, incomplete or corrupt evidence must be unavailable.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Always-support behaviour, invalid evidence acceptance and conflation of absent evidence with a failed measured criterion.
controls.implementation: Real HTTP route controls and independent oracle tests, plus reviewed negative cases with explicit perturbation provenance.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Stop before paid calls on mechanical disagreement; during model trials retain erroneous decisions as outcomes.

controls.description: Native function calling disabled while a model uses an allowlisted text operation envelope through the host.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Assuming MCP requires provider-native function calling or allowing arbitrary model-generated commands.
controls.implementation: Validate operation names and JSON schemas; execute only configured host tools; exercise real MCP through the text route.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: A text adapter failure is an apparatus or transport result, not proof of model evidence-handling inability.

controls.description: The explicit prose prompt receives an ordinary deterministic checker with the same canonical status, check-state and metric contract as EAL, through direct tools without MCP or the EAL runtime.
controls.failure_mode_addressed: Attributing executable checking assistance to EAL notation or MCP alone.
controls.implementation: Run plain_validator against the same immutable report bundles. Report EAL minus plain_validator and, when both arms are assigned, plain_validator minus plain_explicit as separately labelled paired tables.
controls.diagnostic_consequence: Improvement over plain_explicit is evidence about supplying this ordinary checker in the fixed invocation. Agreement with EAL limits an EAL-specific interpretation; residual differences still combine notation, orchestration and implementation and do not isolate syntax.

confounds.description: Notation, prompt length, checking authority and orchestration change together.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Observed effect cannot isolate syntax from host computation.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Define EAL as a combined-system treatment; use shared evidence and final schema. Add plain_validator with the same explicit prose prompt to contrast ordinary checking with direct inspection, and compare EAL with that active control.
confounds.diagnostic: Retain tool traces, token counts and prompts.
confounds.residual_risk: The active comparator helps diagnose checking assistance but does not isolate EAL syntax from orchestration or implementation.

confounds.description: Provider drift and case-family dependence remain despite pairing.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Time-dependent provider behaviour or repeated variants can create shared errors; a finite hand-selected suite is not a probability sample.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Interleave model assignments, seed arm order, share exact evidence and report per model, transport and family.
confounds.diagnostic: Retain timing, bundle hashes, family outcomes and provider failures.
confounds.residual_risk: Development-suite differences do not identify a population effect or class-wide ranking.

confounds.description: Version 4 repairs are informed by observed version 2 and version 3.1 errors.
confounds.causal_or_measurement_path: Post-observation rubric and adapter changes can improve familiar cases without showing out-of-sample performance.
confounds.control_or_adjustment: Label all repaired-case work calibration or development; preserve prior rubrics, traces and scores under their original source revisions.
confounds.diagnostic: Retain old and new protocol versions and state changed measurement contracts.
confounds.residual_risk: A successful calibration is apparatus evidence and cannot establish improved general model accuracy.

estimands.intervention_or_exposure: EAL/2 plus MCP and executable dependency checks.
estimands.comparator: Each of JSON, plain_brief, plain_explicit, plain_review and plain_validator separately within one model snapshot and transport.
estimands.time: The invocation and its fixed snapshots.
estimands.summary_measure: Within model finalisation, assigned-trial model-answer difference; within checked finalisation, assigned-trial retained-result difference between EAL and ordinary validator. In either mode: reference-only correct minus comparator-only correct, divided by all assigned paired cases. Retain both-correct/both-incorrect counts and origin labels.
estimands.interpretation: Describes the finite combined-system contrast within a finalisation mode. Checked results measure the selected checker workflow, not model-authored answer accuracy or a notation effect.

estimands.population_or_system: One orders API, up to 40 purposively reviewed development cases and six pinned snapshots. Model finalisation assigns up to six prompt/tool arms; checked finalisation assigns only EAL/MCP and ordinary validator. Analyse each selected snapshot, transport and finalisation separately. A small calibration precedes an explicitly selected larger invocation; conclusions describe only that finite suite and invocation.
estimands.intervention_or_exposure: Explicit developer prose with an ordinary direct deterministic checker.
estimands.comparator: The identical explicit prose prompt with direct evidence inspection only.
estimands.time: The same invocation, cases, snapshot and transport in model finalisation only, when both arms were assigned.
estimands.summary_measure: (Validator-only correct minus explicit-prose-only correct) divided by all assigned paired cases; retain completed-pair and operational counts.
estimands.interpretation: Describes ordinary checking assistance on the realised finite suite; it does not estimate a population effect or isolate notation.

identification.causal_and_measurement_structure: Shared case evidence and target scope determine independent reference; assigned prompt/tool system plus model and transport produces a decision; component scores determine finite-suite outcome. No sampling bridge to a wider population is asserted.
identified_parameters: Realised assigned-suite paired accuracy differences and component counts
threats: Post-observation instrument repair and rubric ambiguity
diagnostics: Independent oracle and real route controls
Assigned, attempted, completed and failed counts retained separately
rescue_actions: Separate apparatus failures from completed-case error patterns
Suspend affected scores on invalid measurement
Freeze a new held-out protocol before broader inference

Checked finalisation: calibration 3 x 2 x 6 = 36 assignments (6 for one model), smoke 4 x 2 x 6 = 48, pilot 40 x 2 x 6 = 480. Calibration allows 3 model calls/trial and USD0.50/model; smoke and pilot allow 6 calls/trial and USD5/model or USD20/model respectively. inputs: Prior four-profile pilot completed 80/80 correct trials and exposed a ceiling
Families healthy, near_limit, slow, errors, incomplete, wrong_identity, stale, corrupt, conflicting and distractor; four variants each.
Six model snapshots spanning nano, mini and full product tiers in two model families
Six prompt/tool arms; default common text transport
Version 2 retained 628 completed, 131 failed and 441 unattempted assignments; failed-check taxonomy, dual statuses and broad model-stop behaviour require calibration before new comparisons.

Version 3.1 nano-only run retained 141 completed, 43 failed and 56 unattempted assignments. EAL tool results agreed with reference, while model restatement and protocol completion failed; a transient HTTP503 stopped later assignments.
sampling.dependence_structure: Pair arms within model, transport and case; variants share case-family mechanisms and raw acquisition lineage. Calls and HTTP requests are not extra case replications.
sampling.multiplicity: Model finalisation full pilot: 30 EAL/comparator contrasts plus 6 validator/explicit-prose contrasts. Checked full pilot: 6 EAL/validator contrasts. Report only assigned-arm contrasts within each mode; no confirmatory rejection or efficacy decision.
sampling.attrition_or_loss: Retain every assigned trial; failures and unattempted assignments contribute zero correctness in the planned denominator. Report completed-pair counts separately.
sampling.result: The calibration targets observed instrument and stopping-rule failures, not inferential precision. Forty reviewed cases remain an engineering development target rather than a power calculation. No population interval, superiority or equivalence claim follows.
sampling.sensitivity_analysis: Report case-family and component outcomes, complete-pair counts and operational failures. Use observed discordance only to inform simulations for a separately frozen held-out design.
sampling.stopping_implications: Retain every assignment with no effect-based stopping. Retry only provider-marked retryable http_server, timeout or transport failures, at most twice per trial after 1 and 2 seconds; every attempt uses the existing model-call cap and keeps unknown charges reserved. Exhausted transient retries fail that trial; three consecutive transient-failed trials stop the affected model. Known-cost invalid, incomplete or ambiguous replies fail their trial without retry. Fatal account/configuration errors, unclassified failures, unverified returned model identity or usage, host failures, checker/reference disagreement and exhausted admission allowance stop the model immediately. Preserve failed and unattempted assignments separately; instrument or evidence-integrity defects suspend affected comparisons.

analysis.preprocessing_lock: Freeze case catalogue, raw evidence, explicit perturbations, target scopes, assessment times, prompt material, schemas, independent reference and model settings before paid calls. Freeze finalisation and retry/circuit settings with the manifest.
analysis.exclusion_lock: No removal, favourable reruns or response repair after grading.

models.model_or_procedure: Descriptive paired counts within snapshot, transport and finalisation. Model mode reports model-authored decision accuracy; checked mode reports retained checker correctness. Include component errors, valid model-finish and retained-answer counts, optional narrative presence, retries and assigned/completed operational counts.
diagnostics: Count paired completion separately from assignment
Inspect evidence selection, scope, failed-check and transport errors
Compare assigned and completed-pair 2x2 tables; completed-only cases may be selected by provider or transport failures and are diagnostic only.
Distinguish explicit false predicates from null predicates; score both check lists
Inspect provider status, incomplete_details and original public message boundaries before attributing malformed operation output to a model
Separate answer_complete from protocol_complete and retain answer_origin
Inspect retry categories, per-attempt reservations and transient circuit stops

contrasts: plain_validator minus plain_explicit, when both arms are assigned
Each contrast reported separately for each snapshot, transport and finalisation; no pooling across modes or model classes
analysis.uncertainty: No population confidence intervals are reported for this purposively selected development suite. The observed finite-suite difference is exact for the recorded assignments; unobserved model stochasticity, future cases and provider drift remain unresolved.
analysis.multiplicity: Report every prespecified contrast supported by assigned arms for every selected model; no confirmatory efficacy test is performed.
analysis.missing_data: Failed, absent, malformed and unattempted assignments score zero; separate attempted/completed counts and unknown costs expose the operational component. No imputed model answers. Retain a completed-pair 2x2 table to distinguish decision discordance from operational failure, with an explicit selection caveat; do not replace the assigned denominator with that subset.
analysis.stopping_rule: Retain every assignment with no effect-based stopping. Retry only provider-marked retryable http_server, timeout or transport failures, at most twice per trial after 1 and 2 seconds; every attempt uses the existing model-call cap and keeps unknown charges reserved. Exhausted transient retries fail that trial; three consecutive transient-failed trials stop the affected model. Known-cost invalid, incomplete or ambiguous replies fail their trial without retry. Fatal account/configuration errors, unclassified failures, unverified returned model identity or usage, host failures, checker/reference disagreement and exhausted admission allowance stop the model immediately. Preserve failed and unattempted assignments separately; instrument or evidence-integrity defects suspend affected comparisons.
robustness_checks: Report family-specific and component errors without selecting favourable subsets
Distinguish decision discordance among completed valid pairs from provider/transport failures
Keep verdict correctness distinct from full-answer rubric correctness; instrument ambiguity must not be described as an acceptance-decision advantage
Preserve earlier artefacts and scores under their original contracts; version 5 supplies no retrospective replacement score
Never label automatic checked finalisation as model answer accuracy
software_and_versions: Docker image inspection and source SHA retained
analysis.inconclusive_handling: Calibration can establish only operation and instrument behaviour on its small selected cases. Continued ceiling, incomplete responses, incomplete assignments or invalid measurements cannot establish efficacy or equivalence. A larger development invocation requires explicit manual selection; a confirmatory evaluation requires an independent frozen case distribution and simulation-calibrated analysis.

decision_matrix.observation_region: Controls valid; complete planned invocation; at least one interpretable completed-pair discordance.
decision_matrix.decision_rule: Report the finite-suite direction, paired 2x2 table and specific failed components; no efficacy decision.

risks.mechanism: Cases were made more discriminating after the version 1 ceiling; version 3 repairs follow observed version 2 scoring and adapter failures. These are development decisions informed by outcomes.
risks.prevention: Label version 3 calibration/development, freeze every invocation and preserve versions 1 and 2 with original manifests, rubrics and scores.
risks.detection: Report all case families, arms, models and component outcomes.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Do not perform efficacy inference on tuned cases; select independent held-out cases under a new frozen protocol.
risks.residual_risk: One selected API task and hand-picked failures limit external validity.

risks.mechanism: EAL host assessment might leak into the reference or a common collector defect might favour the checked arm.
risks.prevention: Independent raw-row reference, identical frozen bundles and arm-independent final schema.
risks.detection: Real control agreement and component tests; retain source, traces and selected reports.
risks.sensitivity_or_correction: Suspend scores affected by a reference defect and rerun only as new versioned evidence.
risks.residual_risk: Executable checking is part of the EAL treatment; the new ordinary-checker control improves diagnosis but cannot isolate notation from all implementation differences.

researcher_degrees_of_freedom: No within-invocation tuning, case replacement or favourable reruns
Record future case, prompt, threshold or model changes as versioned amendments
falsification_checks: MCP host result must agree with raw reference
Unsupported assertions without measurements cannot pass
reporting_controls: Complete manifest and ledger including failed/unattempted trials
residual_limitations: Six purposively chosen snapshots, not disclosed parameter counts or entire model classes
Forty hand-selected development cases; no powered population inference
Text transport demonstrates host-mediated MCP access but does not identify an intrinsically non-tooling model
Narrative explanations and private reasoning are not independently scored

ethics_and_safety.rationale: No human participants or private datasets; paid API access and runner resources require bounded use.
mitigations: Runtime-only secret environment, excluded from child collector/MCP environments
Only allowlisted schema-validated operation requests; no arbitrary model-generated shell commands
Loopback API acquisition with at most 20 concurrent clients; cases acquired before paid model calls.
Frozen cost admission, call, timeout and output caps
Manual dispatch only; calibration is the default and never automatically triggers a larger run
Default calibration USD0.50/model, USD3 across six models, with three calls/trial and unchanged output cap
stopping_rules: Retain every assignment with no effect-based stopping. Retry only provider-marked retryable http_server, timeout or transport failures, at most twice per trial after 1 and 2 seconds; every attempt uses the existing model-call cap and keeps unknown charges reserved. Exhausted transient retries fail that trial; three consecutive transient-failed trials stop the affected model. Known-cost invalid, incomplete or ambiguous replies fail their trial without retry. Fatal account/configuration errors, unclassified failures, unverified returned model identity or usage, host failures, checker/reference disagreement and exhausted admission allowance stop the model immediately. Preserve failed and unattempted assignments separately; instrument or evidence-integrity defects suspend affected comparisons.
post_stop_actions: Stop this invocation's named paid container before offline summary recovery; retain dispatched attempts with unknown cost when no verified response is available.
Retain incomplete invocation and diagnose it. A fresh invocation requires manual dispatch; only the frozen within-trial transient retries are automatic.

apparatus_or_data: Implemented real HTTP API and collector
Actual stdio MCP server and independent oracle
Responses adapter with native function calling or validated text operation transport
Prior Docker/live feasibility run retained separately
feasibility.access: Repository OPENAI_API_TOKEN secret supplied by operator; exact snapshot access checked by actual calls.
resources: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu runner or explicit registered custom runner, with Docker and outbound package/OpenAI access

reproducibility.data_plan: Retain shared raw measurements, case/provenance digests, explicit fault injections, prompts, EAL/JSON source, model responses, selected evidence, operation traces, component scores, failures and summaries; exclude secrets and private reasoning replay payloads. Version 3 retains public message boundaries, provider status and incomplete_details; final check lists distinguish false from unknown. Version 3.1 checkpoints one slot per dispatched call, with known usage or an unresolved charge reservation. Frozen-case integrity and private raw-reference checks apply to every arm. Version 4 records finalisation, answer origin/completion, protocol completion, narrative presence and retries. Version 5 additionally records the two EAL claim statuses and evidence usability; checker agreement treats numeric rounding within the independent grader tolerance as agreement. Unknown charges retain their reservations. The current plan, manifest and summary schemas are eal-api-experiment/5, eal-api-experiment-run/5 and eal-api-experiment-summary/5 respectively. Raw reports retain eal-live-api-report/2.
reproducibility.code_plan: All implementation and tests committed in this PR.
reproducibility.randomisation_or_seed_plan: Seed 20260925; seeded case/arm order within each concurrent model worker; entire assignment ledger frozen before paid calls.
reproducibility.provenance_plan: Retain source SHA, dependency versions, Docker image inspection, workflow ID and attempt, provider response IDs and usage.
reproducibility.deviation_and_amendment_plan: Increment protocol version for planned changes and preserve historical artefacts, schemas and scores. Version 5 separates evidence usability from negative measured findings in the EAL source and does not replace earlier scores. PR updates and pushes never initiate paid invocations.
reproducibility.replication_plan: Use a fresh output directory and immutable manifest per invocation. Repeating development cases measures repeatability; it does not create independent task coverage. A held-out efficacy study requires a new separately frozen protocol.

change_log: 1.0.0: initial specified protocol; live model outcomes not yet observed.

2.0.0: richer fixed development cases, immutable matched evidence, explicit evidence-validity outcomes, six model tiers and common text-mediated tool operations; replace uninformative v1 decision bounds with descriptive paired tables. Historical v1 feasibility outcomes remain separate. Protocol schema remains 1.0; experiment manifest and raw report become version 2 contracts. EAL/2 syntax and structured/1 semantics are unchanged.

3.0.0: preserve provider termination details and visible message boundaries; make known-cost truncation trial-local; expose one canonical checked status; score false and unknown checks separately; add ordinary direct-validator control and its explicit-prose comparison; default to a 54-assignment manual calibration with USD3 aggregate admission allowance. Historical v1/v2 outcomes and rubrics remain unchanged. Protocol schema stays 1.0, experiment manifest becomes version 3 and raw report remains version 2; EAL/2 syntax and structured/1 semantics are unchanged.

3.1.0: repair interruption and finalization accounting with durable per-call checkpoints; keep unexpected-model costs unknown; verify measurements privately for every arm and enforce invalid-measurement suspension with frozen-case integrity checks; reject malformed report-envelope metadata as an instrument fault; preserve Responses continuation state in the general agent and reject incomplete native function items. Add named-container cleanup and offline summary recovery. Cases, prompts, rubric, model settings and spending limits are unchanged; manifest/summary schemas remain version 3 with additional diagnostics, raw report remains version 2, and EAL/2 language and structured/1 semantics are unchanged.

4.0.0: explicit final-answer templates and concise protocol-only repair feedback; host-bound report identity/scope and optional explanation; separate model and checked finalisation with different assignment identities and origin/completion counts; bounded transient retries within call and cost caps and a three-trial transient circuit. Plan, run manifest and summary schemas advance to version 4. Historical outcomes stay frozen. Protocol document schema remains 1.0, raw report remains version 2, EAL/2 syntax and structured/1 semantics are unchanged.

5.0.0: admissible reports support explicit passing or failing EAL claims through host-installed engineering/api-load-criteria/1; unavailable evidence supports neither claim. The versioned host-status audit now distinguishes supported, unsupported and unavailable; checker numeric agreement uses the independent grading tolerance. Plan, run manifest and summary schemas advance to version 5. Source syntax stays EAL/2; raw reports stay eal-live-api-report/2; the Python package becomes 2.8.0. Development assignments and case IDs are unchanged; historical results retain their own semantics. Live version 5 behaviour remains unmeasured.

prior_evidence.role: feasibility-only; not a result of version 3.0.0
prior_evidence.interpretation: Verified live feasibility and task ceiling across four profiles, four snapshots and five arms. No comparative accuracy advantage or equivalence established.

prior_evidence.role: development and instrument-diagnostic evidence; not a result of version 3.0.0
prior_evidence.interpretation: HTTP/MCP and live-call feasibility verified, with failed-check taxonomy and dual-status ambiguity and three incomplete responses causing excessive downstream stopping. Full GPT-4.1 had EAL 40/40 versus JSON 36/40 full-answer scores but both gave 40/40 correct verdicts. These four JSON discrepancies do not establish better acceptance decisions. Incomplete GPT-5.4 assignments cannot support model-class ranking. Version 3 repairs require fresh live calibration.

prior_evidence.role: development and instrument-diagnostic evidence; frozen original score
prior_evidence.interpretation: Correct tool outputs coexisted with model restatement and protocol failures. All 30 attempted EAL trials selected the correct report and completed MCP assessment; 14 exhausted the six-call limit. A retryable HTTP503 with unknown call cost caused the version 3.1 stop rule to leave 56 later assignments unattempted. These diagnostic findings motivate version 4 and do not establish its performance.

next_investigation_gate.required_before_efficacy: Freeze a new independently selected case distribution after development; do not reuse tuned cases as a confirmatory hold-out.
next_investigation_gate.sample_planning: Simulate paired-difference coverage and power across plausible discordance rates, case-family correlation, model stochasticity, provider drift and missingness; choose an interval/test whose operating characteristics match the declared sampling design.
next_investigation_gate.decision_contract: Declare practical effect margin, estimand, model/comparator family, multiplicity procedure and fixed or sequential stopping rule before observing held-out outcomes.
next_investigation_gate.scope: A snapshot-specific effect on the declared case population; model-class and notation-only claims need additional designs.

calibration_gate.model_selection: All six pinned snapshots by default, or one explicitly selected snapshot.
calibration_gate.purpose: Inspect operation completion, model/checked result separation, optional narrative and bounded transient recovery before an explicitly selected larger invocation.
calibration_gate.advance_rule: Review every assigned result, tool/reference agreement, model/checked origin, protocol completion, retry and cost record. Successful calibration permits a bounded statement about those observations only. Any larger invocation requires explicit manual selection.
calibration_gate.live_validation: Earlier development results retain their original protocols. Version 5 live calibration is pending; this change neither starts a paid run nor establishes a live result.
calibration_gate.workflow_trigger: workflow_dispatch only; no push or pull_request trigger

finalisation_contract.model: The model supplies status, check sets and metrics through an explicit finish. The host binds omitted report_id/scope and rejects explicit conflicts. Explanation is optional and its presence is recorded.
finalisation_contract.checked: Only EAL/MCP and plain_validator are assigned. After model selection and successful inspection the host retains the checker decision directly, labelled checked origin rather than model answer accuracy.
finalisation_contract.pooling: Keep invocations, assignment identities and summaries separate by finalisation.

provider_recovery.accounting: Every dispatched attempt counts against the same trial call cap. Retain unknown charges and their reservations. Do not retry semantic errors, output truncation, authentication/configuration failures or unverified returned identity/usage.
